steps.epl: @name('create') @public create window MyWindowTOW#time_order(value, 10 sec) as MySimpleKeyValueMap
insert into MyWindowTOW select theString as key, longBoxed as value from SupportBean
@name('s0') select irstream key, value as value from MyWindowTOW
@name('delete') on SupportMarketDataBean delete from MyWindowTOW where symbol = key
@name('create') @public create window MyWindow.ext:time_order(value, 10) as select theString as key, longBoxed as value from SupportBean
insert into MyWindow(key, value) select irstream theString, longBoxed from SupportBean
@name('delete') on SupportMarketDataBean as s0 delete from MyWindow as s1 where s0.symbol = s1.key
@name('create') create window MyWindowTA#time_accum(10 sec) as MySimpleKeyValueMap
insert into MyWindowTA select theString as key, longBoxed as value from SupportBean
@name('s0') select irstream key, value as value from MyWindowTA
@name('delete') on SupportMarketDataBean as s0 delete from MyWindowTA as s1 where s0.symbol = s1.key
@name('create') @public create window MyWindow.win:time_accum(10 sec) as select theString as key, intBoxed as value from SupportBean
